skills.n: Join the Battle of All Battles
skills.d:
This Skill can only be used if your Deck contains at most 6 non-Cyberse Type monsters and the only Level 5 or higher monsters in your Deck are Level 6, 7, and 10 Cyberse Type monsters.
[REQUIREMENT] If you do not control any monsters, reveal 1 "Sigurstate Sol" or 1 "Belsectacle Mani" in your hand.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Cyberse Type Normal Monster or 1 "Fusion" from your Graveyard to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Performage Trapeze Magician" to your Extra Deck.
2: During the Main Phase of a turn that you took effect damage, shuffle 1 Spellcaster monster from your Graveyard or your banished cards into the Deck.

You can only use this Skill's second, third, and fourth effects once per turn.
1: You cannot Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) monsters except for "Performage" and Level 4 Spellcaster monsters.
2: Send 1 "Performage" monster from your hand to the Graveyard, and then add 1 "Performage" monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: Shuffle 1 monster on your field into the Deck, and then play 1 "Performage" monster from your Deck to your field in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
4: If you control a "Performage" Xyz Monster, the ATK of 1 monster on your field becomes equal to the ATK of the monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK +1000, until the end of this turn.

You can only use this Skill once per Duel if your Deck (excluding the Extra Deck) contains 8 or more Level 4 or lower LIGHT and/or Spellcaster monsters.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 LIGHT and/or Spellcaster monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck, and then take 1 "Performage" monster from your Deck and either add it to your hand or send it to the Graveyard.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn and twice per Duel.
1: You cannot Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) monsters except for "Performage" and Level 4 Spellcaster monsters.
2: You can activate one of the following effects.
● Add 1 "Wonder Wand", 1 "Bound Wand", or 1 "One-Shot Wand" at random from outside your Deck to your hand, and then place 1 "Performage" monster from your hand to the bottom of the Deck.
● Add 1 "Performage" monster from your Deck to your hand, and then place 1 "Wonder Wand", 1 "Bound Wand", or 1 "One-Shot Wand" from your hand to the bottom of the Deck.

You can only use this Skill if your Extra Deck contains 2 or more Rank 4 or lower Xyz Monsters.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, gain 1600 Life Points.
2: During the End Phase of a turn that you successfully Special Summoned a Rank 4 or lower monster, gain 400 Life Points.

skills.n: Set - Mighty Gaze of the Sky Emperor
skills.d:
[REQUIREMENT] You have a face-up Level 10 Maximum Monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Mighty Gaze of the Sky Emperor" from your Deck or Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

This Skill can only be used if all of the monsters with 1300 or more ATK in your Deck are Dragon monsters, and the Deck contains 1 or less non-DARK Attribute Level 6 or higher monster.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up Level 5 or 7 DARK Attribute monster on your field and its original ATK becomes 2600 until the end of this turn. Then, if it was "Steel Strike Dragon Metagias“ that was Summoned this turn, you can add 1 DARK Attribute Level 7 monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

This Skill can only be used if all of the monsters with 1400 or more ATK in your Deck are Warrior and/or Winged Beast monsters.
[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, during the turn that you have Normal Summoned a Level 6 or higher monster.
[EFFECT] Send up to 2 DARK Attribute Warrior monsters with different names from your hand or Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can make 1 face-up WATER Attribute Winged Beast monster on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

This Skill can only be used if all of the monsters in your Deck are Psychic monsters, and the Deck contains 1 or less Level 7 or higher non-LIGHT Attribute monster.
[REQUIREMENT] Shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, and then you show your opponent 1 Level 7 LIGHT Attribute monster in your hand or 1 face-up "CAN - Re:D" on your field.
[EFFECT] Add 1 Level 1 or 4 LIGHT Attribute monster with 100 or less DEF from your Graveyard to your hand. (You can only add an Effect Monster once per Duel.)

This Skill can be used if your Deck contains 7 or more Level 5 or higher monsters and no Level 7 or higher Dragon Type monsters with 1900 DEF or lower.
[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, if there are no face-up Level 8 or higher monsters on your field, shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck and reveal 1 "Kaibaman" in your hand.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Blue-Eyes Bright Dragon" from your Deck to your hand.

You can use this Skill if your Extra Deck contains a DARK Link Monster.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, gain 1500 Life Points.
2: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can choose 1 face-up on your field, and it gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. It gains an additional 500 ATK until the end of the turn if there is a DARK Link Monster OR a DARK monster and a Link Monster, on your field and/or in your Graveyard.

This Skill can be used twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, place 1 Level 5 or higher Zombie monster from your hand on the bottom of your Deck, then draw 1 card.

You can use this Skill's first effect twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, shuffle 3 monsters, including a Plant monster, from your Graveyard or banished cards into the Deck. Then, draw 1 card.

You can only use this Skill's first effect once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, return any number of Link Monsters whose total Link Arrows equals 4 or lower from your Graveyard to your Extra Deck. Then, you can make 1 monster your opponent controls lose ATK equal to the total of those Link Arrows x 100.

You can use this Skill if your Extra Deck contains a EARTH Link Monster.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, gain 1500 Life Points.
2: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can choose 1 face-up on your field, and it gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. It gains an additional 500 ATK until the end of the turn if there is a EARTH Link Monster OR a EARTH monster and a Link Monster, on your field and/or in your Graveyard.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During this Duel, you can Normal Summon/Set monsters whose sum of ATK and DEF equals 4000 without Tributing, but you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters, except DARK Cyberse or DARK Dragon monsters.
2: Reveal 1 Level 7 or higher Dragon monster in your hand, and then send 2 Level 7 or higher Dragon monsters from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard, and add 1 monster whose sum of ATK and DEF equals 4000 from your Deck to your hand. This turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except Link Monsters.
3: If a monster is on your opponent's field or in their Graveyard, play 1 Link-2 "Borrel" monster from your Extra Deck to your field.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per turn.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters except for "The Agent" monsters, "Hyperion" monsters, Synchro Monsters, and Normal Monsters.
2: During your Main Phase, send 1 "The Agent" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can apply the following effect.
● Shuffle 1 "Hyperion" monster or 1 "Mystical Shine Ball" from your hand into the Deck, then add 1 "Hyperion" monster or 1 "The Agent of Creation - Venus" from your Deck to your hand.
3: During your Main Phase, choose 1 Fairy monster on your field, and treat that monster as a Tuner.

You can use this Skill's first and second effects if your Deck (excluding the Extra Deck) contains 12 or more "Traptrix" monsters, and all of the monsters in your Extra Deck are Xyz Monsters.
1: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can play 1 "Traptrix" monster from your hand to your field.
2: Once per Duel, during your Main Phase, if it is turn 2 and onward, you can send 1 "Traptrix" monster or "Hole" Normal Trap Card from your hand to the Graveyard, and then add 1 "Treacherous Trap Hole" from outside of your Deck to your Deck. Then, you can add 1 "Traptrix" monster or "Hole" Normal Trap Card from your Deck to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters, except Cyberse monsters.
2: If your Extra Deck contains a Link-5 monster, reveal 1 "Firewall" monster or Ritual Monster in your hand, and then banish 5 monsters from outside of your Deck (these monsters can be Special Summoned) and add 1 "Cynet" Spell Card from your Deck to your hand. If you activated this effect on the 2nd turn onward, also add 1 "Cynet Rollback" from outside of your Deck to your hand.
3: If you have Special Summoned "Decode Talker" during this Duel, shuffle up to 5 cards from your Graveyard and/or among your banished cards into the Deck.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 each of 3 "Sunvine" monsters with different names to your Extra Deck. During this Duel, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except EARTH Plant monsters or Link Monsters.
2: Shuffle 1 monster from your hand into the Deck, and then add 1 "Sunvine" Effect Monster or "Sunseed" Effect Monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: If a monster is on your opponent's field, shuffle 1 Plant monster from your hand, face-up field, Graveyard, or among your banished cards into the Deck, and then you can play 1 "Sunseed Genius Loci" from your Deck to your field in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, if all of the monsters in your Extra Deck are Link Monsters with different names, add 5 "Sunavalon" monsters with different names to your Extra Deck, also for the rest of this Duel, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except EARTH Plant monsters or Link Monsters.
2: Shuffle 1 "Sunavalon" monster, "Sunvine" monster, or "Sunseed" monster from your hand into the Deck, then add 1 "Sunseed Genius Loci" from your Deck, Graveyard, or among your banished cards to your hand.

1: Once per Duel, before your normal draw, you can change 1 of the cards from your normal draw this turn to "Sunseed Genius Loci" in your Deck. During this Duel, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except EARTH Plant monsters or Link Monsters.

1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Sunavalon Dryatrentiay" to your Extra Deck and if there are two or less "Sunseed Genius Loci" in your Deck, add 0–3 "Sunseed Genius Loci" so that it contains 3 copies.
2: During the End Phase, if you took battle or effect damage this turn, gain 500 LP.

You can use this Skill's first, second, and third effects once per Duel if your Deck (excluding the Extra Deck) contains 6 or more Spellcaster monsters with 2900 ATK.
1: Activates at the start of your first turn. During this Duel, you can Normal Summon/Set DARK Spellcaster monsters with 2900 ATK without Tributing. If this Skill was activated on the 2nd turn, also play 1 "Necro Fleur" from outside of your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: Shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, then play 1 "Necro Synchron" from your Deck. Then, you can decrease the Level of 1 monster on your field by 1 or 2.
3: Send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard, then play 1 "Sorciere de Fleur" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

This Skill can be used if all the monsters with 1400 or more ATK in the Deck are Plant Type.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up Level 7 EARTH Attribute Plant Type monster on your field. The chosen monster gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. If that monster was "Etraynze the Shadow Flower Ninja" Special Summoned this turn, that monster inflicts piercing battle damage this turn.

This Skill can be used if the only monsters in your Deck are Spellcaster or Warrior Type monsters with 2100 or less ATK, and the Deck contains 8 or more Maximum Monsters.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Choose up to 2 face-up Maximum Monsters with 1500 or less ATK on your field. The chosen monster(s) gain 1200 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can place 1 random Maximum Monster from your Deck with a different Level than the chosen monster(s) on top of your Deck.

[REQUIREMENT] At the beginning of the Duel.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Wyrm Excavator the Heavy Cavalry Draco [L]", 1 "Wyrm Excavator the Heavy Cavalry Draco", and 1 "Wyrm Excavator the Heavy Cavalry Draco [R]" to your Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies of each card.)

This Skill can be used if all of the monsters with 1200 or more ATK in your Deck are Wyrm Type.
[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward.
[EFFECT] Choose from your field, 1 face-up Normal Monster (except a Level 4 monster) or 1 "Constructor Wyrm Buildragon". The chosen monster gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. If that monster was "Constructor Princess Pylon", you can also shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, and if you do, add 1 "Peaks of Blisstopia" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

This Skill can be used if all of the monsters in your Deck are Wyrm Type.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Choose 1 face-up monster on your field. This turn, that monster gains 100 ATK, and if there were 13 or less cards in your Deck when you used this Skill, it inflicts piercing battle damage. If you have activated "Peaks of Blisstopia" this turn, you can also add 1 Level 3 or 10 monster from your Graveyard to your hand. (You can only add a Maximum Monster once per Duel.)

This Skill can be used if all of the monsters with 1600 ATK or higher in your Deck are "Constructor Wyrm Buildragon", "Shield Boring Kong", "Beast Drive Mega Elephant",  "Night Vision the Phantom Pigeon", and an EARTH Attribute Legend Monster.
[REQUIREMENT] During the turn that you have Normal Summoned a monster with 1600 or more ATK.
[EFFECT] Change 1 Attack Position monster on your opponent's field to face-up Defense Position.

[REQUIREMENT] Before your normal draw, if your opponent has a face-up Level 5 or higher monster on their field, shuffle a total of 3 Wyrm Type monsters and/or "Peaks of Blisstopia" from your Graveyard into the Deck. (Once per Duel.)
[EFFECT] One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be 1 "Constructor Princess Pylon" or 1 "Peaks of Blisstopia" from your Deck. This turn, you cannot attack with Level 7 or higher monsters, except for Wyrm Type monsters.

This Skill can be used if your Deck contains 5 or more Warrior Type monsters with 2600 or 2300 ATK and no other monsters with 1300 or more ATK.
[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Until the end of this turn, all face-up monsters with 2300 or more ATK on your opponent's field lose 500 ATK and become Dragon Type, then if it is turn 4 onward, you can also send 1 card from your hand and 1 Level 7 monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. (Once per Duel.)

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You can Normal Summon "Dark Magician" and "Buster Blader" without Tributing, but you cannot Special Summon Level 2 or higher monsters except for "Buster Blader" monsters and Level 6 or higher DARK Spellcaster monsters and Level 7 or higher DARK Dragon monsters with 2400 or less ATK.
2: Shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, reveal 1 "Dark Magician" in your hand, then play 1 "Buster Blader" from your hand or Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
3: During a turn that you Normal Summoned "Dark Magician", add 1 "Polymerization" and 1 "Diffusion Wave-Motion" from outside of your Deck to your hand.

You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel, if your Deck contains the Sacred Beasts ("Raviel, Lord of Phantasms", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", and "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames".)
1: You cannot Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) Effect Monsters, except for the Sacred Beasts and monsters that mentions any of the Sacred Beasts in their text.
2: Reveal 1 of the Sacred Beasts from your hand, shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, and add 1 of the Sacred Beasts or 1 monster that mentions any of the Sacred Beasts from your Deck to your hand.
3: If your opponent has a card(s) on their field or in their Graveyard, shuffle 1 monster from your hand or field into the Deck, and play 1 of the Sacred Beasts from your Deck to your field in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

This Skill can be used twice per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, place 1 Level 5 or higher Fiend monster from your hand on the bottom of your Deck, then draw 1 card.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per turn.
1: You cannot Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck and your opponent's Graveyard) monsters, except for "Frightfur", "Fluffal", and "Edge Imp" monsters.
2: Shuffle 1 "Edge Imp" monster from your hand or face-up field into the Deck, and add 1 "Edge Imp" monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: During your Main Phase, equip 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field to 1 "Frightfur Bear" on your field, as if it were equipped by the effect of "Frightfur Bear".

You can only use this Skill's second, third, and fourth effects once per turn.
1: You cannot Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) monsters, except for "Performage" and Level 4 Spellcaster monsters.
2: Send 1 "Performage" monster from your hand to the Graveyard, and then add 1 "Performage" monster from your Deck or 1 "Polymerization" from outside of your Deck to your hand.

(Their battle positions can be changed.) 3: If there is a card on your opponent's field, send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! Play 1 "Star Seraph" monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position (its battle position can be changed), then add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force" from outside of your Deck to your hand.

 1: Can be used before your normal draw if your opponent controls a card. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random "Star Seraph" monster from your Deck.

You can use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel if your Deck contains a total of 15 or more "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" cards or cards that mention it.
1: Reveal 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster from your hand and add 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" or another card that mentions it from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" and 1 "Black Luster Soldier" from outside your Deck to the Graveyard.
2: If you control a "Blue-Eyes" monster or only your opponent controls a monster, Set 1 Spell/Trap card that mentions "Blue-Eyes White Dragon". (This card can be activated the same turn.)

You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Kaiser Sea Horse" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: If you control "Kaiser Sea Horse", you can Normal Summon a LIGHT monster with 1 less Tribute this turn.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Guardian Angel Joan" to your Deck.
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your LP are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random LIGHT Fairy monster from your Deck.

You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Gain 2000 LP. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Injection Fairy Lily", and you can Normal Summon 1 "Injection Fairy Lily" in addition to your Normal
Summon/Set. "Injection Fairy Lily" can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.
2: Reveal 1 Fairy monster or EARTH monster from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck contains no more than 4 non-LIGHT/non-WIND monsters.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except "Guardian Angel Joan" and Dragon monsters. You can Normal Summon 1 "Guardian Angel Joan" during your Main Phase in addition to your Normal Summon/Set, and "Guardian Angel Joan" can be Normal Summoned/Set without Tributing, also you can only draw cards by card effects once per turn.
2: Reveal 1 "Luster Dragon #2", "Luster Dragon", or "Guardian Angel Joan" from your hand. Add 1 "Guardian Angel Joan" or Dragon Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 Dragon monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.
3: If you control "Guardian Angel Joan", add 1 "Graceful Charity" and 1 "Stamping Destruction" from outside your Deck to your hand, then play up to 1 "Luster Dragon #2" and 1 "Luster Dragon" (up to 2 cards total) from your Deck to your field in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

You can only use this Skill's first effect once per Duel, and its second and third effects once per turn.
1: Can be activated from turn 2 onward. Play 1 "Fire Princess" in face-down Defense Position from outside your Deck. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: Can be activated during a turn in which you have gained LP. All monsters you control gain ATK/DEF equal to the difference between your LP and that of your opponent until the end of the next turn.
3: Can be activated during a turn in which your opponent has taken effect damage from one of your cards. All monsters your opponent controls lose ATK/DEF equal to the difference between your LP and that of your opponent until the end of the next turn.

skills.n: O' Goddess with the Third Eye!
skills.d:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Goddess with the Third Eye" to your Deck.
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your LP are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random LIGHT Fairy monster from your Deck.

You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Set 1
"Polymerization" from outside your Deck. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a "Goddess with the Third Eye".
2: Reveal 1 Spellcaster monster or 1 Spell Card from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Summon or Special Summon any monsters, except Fusion Monsters and LIGHT or DARK monsters.
2: During your Main Phase, add 1 "Polymerization", 1 "The Forgiving Maiden", and 1 "Darklord Marie" from outside your Deck to your hand. During this Duel, you cannot Special Summon any monsters, except LIGHT Fusion Monsters, until you Fusion Summon a LIGHT Fusion Monster.
3: If you control "St. Joan" or only your opponent controls a monster, draw 2 cards. Then, shuffle 2 cards from your hand into the Deck.

skills.n: Deck Master: "Goddess with the Third Eye"
skills.d:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Goddess with the Third Eye" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: If you control "Goddess with the Third Eye", send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard, then add 1 "Polymerization" from outside your Deck to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of your first turn, Set 1 "Temple of the Mind's Eye" from outside your Deck.
2: If you control a card in your Field Zone, shuffle 1 card from your hand into your Deck, then add 1 "Rod of the Mind's Eye" from outside your Deck to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane" and 1 "Shinato's Ark" to your Deck.
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your LP are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random Ritual Monster or Ritual Spell Card from your Deck.

skills.n: Deck Master: "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane"
skills.d:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: If you control "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane", change an Attack Position monster your opponent controls to Defense Position. Then, halve your opponent's LP. During this rest of this Duel, your opponent will take no effect damage except that of "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane".

You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a Spirit monster. This turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except for Spirit monsters, and you can Normal Summon up to 3 times. Also, you can Normal Summon Spirit monsters without Tributing.
2: Reveal 1 Spirit monster or 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effect once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) Effect monsters, except Spirit monsters. You can Normal Summon/Set twice a turn.
2. Reveal 1 Spirit monster or 1 Ritual Spell Card in your hand, then add 1 Spirit monster or 1 Spell/Trap Card that mentions "Spirit monster" in its text from your Deck to your hand.
3: If only your opponent controls a monster, play 1
"Shinato, King of a Higher Plane" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

You can only use one of this Skill's first or second effects per turn (1 effect per turn).
1: Reveal 1 Ritual Monster or 1 Ritual Spell Card, then shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, and add 1 Ritual Monster or 1 Ritual Spell Card to your hand.
2: Reveal 1 Ritual Spell Card and 1 Ritual Monster that is mentioned on that card from your hand, Set 1 "Urgent Ritual Art" from outside your Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

You can use this Skill's first effect once per turn and up to twice per Duel if your Deck contains 6 or more LIGHT monsters.
1: During your Main Phase, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard, then draw 2 cards. If it is the first turn of the player going second, draw 1 additional card.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: During this Duel, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0.
2: Place up to 2 Level 4 monsters or Normal Monsters from your hand on the bottom of your Deck in any order, then draw the same number of cards. Then, play 1 "Rescue Rabbit" from your hand or Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are LIGHT Attribute monsters with 500 or 2000 DEF, and if there are 2 or more different Level 10 monsters in your Extra Deck.
[MULTI-CHOICE EFFECT]
●Send 1 "Imaginary Actor" or "Monster Reincarnation" from your Deck to your Graveyard. (Each card once per Duel.)
●Add 1 "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. (Once per Duel.)

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated by sending 1 Level 7 or 8 monster from your hand to the Graveyard if all of the monsters in your Deck and Extra Deck are LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Place up to 2 Level 7 or 8 monsters from your hand and/or Graveyard in face-up Defense Position. If it is turn 2 onward, you can also add 1 Level 7 or 8 monster from your Graveyard to your hand. While the monsters placed on the field using this effect are face-up, their battle positions can only be changed by card effects. This turn, monsters with an original Level of 7 or higher can attack directly only once.

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward before your normal draw. (Twice per Duel if going first, thrice per Duel if going second.)
[EFFECT] Place 1 "Music Princess's Battle Ballet" or "Straight Pierce" from your Deck or Graveyard on top of your Deck. (Only one per Duel if "Music Princess's Battle Ballet".) In this Draw Phase, if you would draw until you have 5 cards for your normal draw, instead draw until you have 6 cards.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of your first turn, send 1 LIGHT Machine monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, then place 1 "Boss on Parade" card from outside your Deck face-up on your field. During all of your turns, you can Normal Summon 2 times, but you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except LIGHT Machine monsters with 1200 or less ATK and 1000 or less DEF, "Gradius' Option", and Tokens.
2: During your Main Phase, you can add monsters to your hand up to the number of LIGHT Machine monsters you control + 1, choosing among the LIGHT Machine monsters in your Deck and/or "Gradius' Option" cards from outside your Deck.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During your turn, you cannot Special Summon any monsters, except "B.E.S." monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: Send "Boss Rush" or 1 Spell/Trap Card that mentions it from your hand or face-up field to the Graveyard, and then add 1 "B.E.S." monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: Can be activated from turn 2 onward. If you control no cards in your Field Zone, Set 1 "B.E.F. Zelos" card from your Deck, otherwise draw 1 card or add 1 "Super B.E.S. Metal Slave" card from your Deck to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except DARK Dragon monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Rokket" Tuner card in your hand, then add 1 DARK Dragon monster whose sum of ATK and DEF equals 4000, as well as 1 "Quick Launch" from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control "Borreload Dragon", or only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Rokket" monster or 1 "Borrel" monster with 3000 or less ATK from your Deck, Extra Deck, or Graveyard.

You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. This turn, one of the cards from your normal draw will be an "Icarus Attack" or a random Winged Beast monster from your Deck. Then, you can activate "Icarus Attack" from your hand. 
2: Reveal 1 Winged Beast monster or 1 Trap Card in your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

You can only use this Skill’s second and third effects once per turn.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters except Pendulum Monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: Reveal 1 "Vaylantz" card from your hand and then add 1 "Vaylantz" card that is a different type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) from your revealed card from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control a Level 10 or higher "Vaylantz" monster, or only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 of your "Mamonaka the Vaylantz United" monsters that is in your Extra Deck, Graveyard, or has been banished. If it is turn 2 onward, also shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck.

You can only use this Skill's first effect once per turn, and the second effect once per Duel.
1: Reveal 1 "Hallo, the Spirit of Tricks" or "Ween, the Spirit of Treats" from your hand, then add 1 "Hallo-Ween!" from your Deck to your hand. This turn, you can Normal Summon up to 3 times; however, monsters other than "Hallo, the Spirit of Tricks" and "Ween, the Spirit of Treats" can only be Summoned once.
2: If only your opponent controls a monster, add 1 "Hallo-Ween!" from your Deck to your hand.

You can use this Skill’s second and third effects once per turn if your Deck contains 8 or more "Libromancer" monsters with different names.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon any Effect Monsters except "Libromancer" monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: Reveal 1 "Libromancer" monster with 2000 or less ATK in your hand, then shuffle 1 card from your hand or field into the Deck. Add 1 Ritual Monster and 1 "Libromancer" monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: If only your opponent controls a monster, Set 1 Spell/Trap Card. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Barian
Battlemorph! Regain your true form! You can send 3 Rank 5 "Number C" monsters with different names that have a number "101" or higher in their name from your Extra Deck to your Graveyard, and send 3 monsters with the same names from outside of your Deck to your opponent's Graveyard. Then, play 1 "Number 104: Masquerade" card from your Extra Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force" or "Rank-Up-Magic Admiration of the Thousands".
2: Reveal 1 DARK monster or Spell Card from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Dark Magician Girl" from outside of your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: If you control "Dark Magician Girl", draw 1 card. If you have monsters in your Graveyard, you can excavate cards from the top of your Deck, up to the number of monsters in your Graveyard. Then, add 1 of those cards to your hand. Shuffle the rest back into your Deck.

You can use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel if your Deck contains a total of 2 or more different Trap Cards.
1: During your Main Phase, draw 1 card or add 1
"Makyura the Destructor" from your Deck to your hand. Then, shuffle 1 card from your hand into your Deck. This turn, you can Normal Summon 1 "Makyura the Destructor" in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.
2: Reveal 1 "Makyura the Destructor" in your hand, add 1 random Trap Card from your Deck to your hand. This turn, you can activate 1 Trap Card from your hand. Once during this turn, you can activate 1 Trap Card from your hand, and your opponent will take no effect damage for the remainder of the Duel.

You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Extra Deck contains a total of 3 or more different "Fusion Dragon" monsters.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except DARK Dragon or Plant monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Predaplant" monster from your hand, then add 1 Level 1 or 8 "Predaplant" monster from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control a "Fusion Dragon" monster, or only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 Level 8 or lower "Predaplant" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck. Then, add 1 "Predaprime Fusion" from your Deck to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special
Summon (Excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck or Graveyard) any monsters with 3000 or less ATK, except "Mikanko" monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Mikanko" monster from your hand and add 1 "Mikanko" card from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 "Mikanko" Spell Card from your Deck to the Graveyard. You can then send 1 card from your hand or field to the Graveyard.
3: If only your opponent controls a monster, Set 1 "Mikanko" Spell/Trap Card from your hand or Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel. 
1: At the beginning of your first turn, Set 1 "Beetrooper Formation" from outside your Deck, then send 2 Insect monsters, including "Beetrooper" monsters, from your Deck to the Graveyard. For the rest of this Duel, you cannot Special Summon any monsters, except Insect monsters.
2: If you control an Insect monster with 3000 or more ATK, or your opponent controls a monster, gain 3000 LP. Then, add 1 Level 5 or higher Insect monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand, or Set 1 "Beetrooper" Spell/Trap  card from your Deck or Graveyard. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn, and the third effect once per Duel.
1: You can Normal Summon 1 "Primal Dragon, the
Primordial" in addition to your regular Normal Summon/Set, and your opponent takes no effect damage from your card effects.
2: Reveal 1 "Ten Thousand Dragon" or "Primal Dragon, the Primordial" in your hand. Add 1 "Ten Thousand Dragon" or "Primal Dragon, the Primordial" from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 Dragon monster with 3000 ATK from your Deck or Extra Deck to the Graveyard.
3: If you control "Ten Thousand Dragon", or your opponent controls a monster, you can add 1 card from your Deck to your hand, or play any number of "Primal Dragon, the Primordial" in face-down Defense Position from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard. (Its battle position can be changed.)

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward if all of the monsters with 1300 or more ATK in your contructed Deck are LIGHT Attribute Warrior Type monsters. 
[EFFECT] Send up to 2 cards ("Elemental HERO Neos" and/or "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin", and/or "Neo-Spacian Flare Scarab") from your hand to the Graveyard, then draw that many cards. If you have "Elemental HERO Neos" in your Graveyard, you can also add 1 "Hero Descent" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. (Once per Duel.)

[REQUIREMENT] Activated at the beginning of the Duel if your contructed Deck includes 15 or more Machine Type monsters with 800 DEF.
[EFFECT] Add 3 "Vic Viper Full Custom" to your Extra Deck.

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward before your normal draw. (Once per Duel if going first, twice
per Duel if going second.)
[EFFECT] Place 1 "Cornful Charity" from your Deck or
Graveyard on top of your Deck. In this Draw Phase, if you would draw until you have 5 cards for your normal draw, instead draw until you have 6 cards.

[REQUIREMENT] None
[EFFECT] Make 1 face-up Level 8 Aqua Type monster you control gain 800 ATK until the end of this turn. If your LP are lower than your opponent's, gain 2000 LP. (Once per Duel.)

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 Level 8 monster with 1000 DEF from your hand if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are EARTH, WATER, or FIRE Attribute Aqua Type monsters, except those with 500 DEF.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 cards (Normal Monsters with 1200 or less ATK or 0 DEF, and/or "Nuvia the Mischievous", and or "Rainapolis") from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. This turn, your monsters can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of Level 8 monsters with 1000 DEF in Attack Position.

[REQUIREMENT] Activated at the beginning of the Duel. 
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Dian Keto the Cure Prodigy" to your Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies.)

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during a turn you Normal or Special Summoned "Dian Keto the Cure Prodigy". 
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Nuvia the Mischievous" or "Rainapolis" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During this Duel, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0.
2: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Mystical Elf" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
3: If you control a "Mystical Elf", draw 1 card and excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck. Then, add 1 of the cards to your hand and shuffle the other back into your Deck.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: If you Xyz Summon "Number 103: Ragnazero" or WATER Winged Beast Xyz Monster(s), you can use 1 Level 5 or lower WATER Winged Beast monster you control as material to Xyz Summon. You cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except WATER Winged Beast monsters and Xyz Monsters. During this Duel, monsters your opponent control loses 100 ATK.
2: Reveal 1 Winged Beast monster from your hand. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! Add 2 Level 4 WATER Winged Beast monsters from your Deck to your hand and send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force" from outside your Deck to your hand. If your opponent controls a monster, you can also play 1 Level 4 WATER Winged Beast monster from your Deck.

You can only use this Skill's first effect once per turn.
1: Can be activated during your Main Phase. Barian Battlemorph! Regain your true form! You can play 1 "Number 103: Ragnazero" or "Ice Beast Zerofyne" (each card can only be played once per Duel) in face-down Defense Position from your Extra Deck (its battle position can be changed) and attach 2 "Blizzard Thunderbird" from outside your Deck to that monster as Xyz Material, also until the end of your opponent's turn, monsters your opponent control loses 100 ATK.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Number 103: Ragnazero" to your Extra Deck.
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your LP are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random WATER Winged Beast monster from your Deck.

You can only use this Skill's first effect once per Duel.
1: Reveal 1 Level 4 monster in your hand. Add 1 Level 4 monster with the same Type and Attribute from your Deck to your hand and place the monster you revealed on the bottom of your Deck. Then, draw 1 card. If your opponent controls a monster, this turn, you can also Normal Summon 1 Level 4 monster during your Main Phase in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.

You can use this Skill if your Extra Deck contains a WATER Xyz Monster.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, gain 1500 Life Points.
2: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can choose 1 face-up on your field, and it gains 300 ATK until the end of this turn. It gains an additional 500 ATK until the end of the turn if there is a WATER Xyz Monster OR a WATER monster and an Xyz Monster, on your field and/or in your Graveyard.

skills.n: The Eye of the United Dragon
skills.d:
You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck contains a total of 15 or more "Dark Magician" and/or cards that mention it.
1:Activated at the beginning of the Duel. If you are going first, during the first turn, your opponent will take no effect damage from your effects.
2: Shuffle 1 card from your hand into your Deck. Play 1 "Timaeus the United Dragon" from your hand, then add a total of 2 cards among "Dark Magician" and/or a card(s) that mentions it from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control a "Dark Magician", or your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl" that has a different name than the monsters you control from your Deck in face-down Defense Position (its battle position can be changed), then add 1 "The Eye of Timaeus" from outside your Deck to your hand.

You can use this Skill's second effect once per turn and twice per Duel.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters except for cards that mention "Fallen of Albaz" or "Fallen of Albaz", or "Ecclesia", "Tri-Brigade", "Springans", "Swordsoul", or "Icejade" monsters. If your opponent has a card on their field or in their Graveyard, you can Normal Summon 1 monster during your Main Phase in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.
2: Reveal 1 "Fallen of Albaz" or 1 monster that mentions it, then add a total of 2 cards among "Ecclesia", "Tri-Brigade", "Springans", "Swordsoul", "Icejade" cards, and/or "Branded in High Spirits" from your Deck to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters except "Drytron" monsters or Ritual Monsters, or Normal Summon any monsters, except LIGHT monsters.
2: Reveal 1 Level 1 "Drytron" monster from your hand, then add 1 Ritual Monster or "Meteonis Drytron" from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 Level 1 "Drytron" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.
3: If your opponent controls a monster, add 1 "Drytron" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand.

You can use thie Skill's first and second effects once per Duel if your Deck contains 6 or more "Zoodiac" monsters, and no Beast-Warrior monsters other than Level 4 Beast-Warrior monsters.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 2 "Zoodiac Ratpier" and 6 "Zoodiac" Xyz Monsters with different names to your Deck and Extra Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies of each card.) During this Duel, you can only Special Summon "Zoodiac" monsters and monsters with 2000 or less ATK (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck). 
2: Can be activated from turn 2 onward. PLay 1 Beast-Warrior Type monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set from your Deck in face-down Defense Position (its battle position can be changed).

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: During your turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck or those from your opponent's Graveyard or banished cards) any monsters, except EARTH Insect or Plant monsters.
2: Reveal 1 "Traptrip Garden" or "Traptrix Holeutea" from your hand and send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. Then, selecting from among "Traptrix" monsters as well as "Hole" and/or "Trap Hole" Normal Trap Cards, add a total of 2 cards from your Deck to your hand.
3: During a turn in which your opponent has activated an effect, you can Normal Summon up to 2 times. From turn 2 onward, you can also play 1 "Traptrix" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck.

You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per turn.
1: At the beginning of your Main Phase, send up to 2 EARTH "Dragon Ruler" monsters from your hand to the Graveyard, then draw the same number of cards.
2: Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 EARTH "Dragon Ruler" monster in your hand, then add 1 EARTH "Dragon Ruler" with a different Level from your Deck to your hand.

[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon", "Summoned Skull", or "Change Slime - Skull Dragon Mode" from your hand from turn 2 onward if all of the Level 5 or higher monsters in your constructed Deck are "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" and "Showdown Skull Archfiend".
[EFFECT] Add 2 cards from among Level 7 monsters, "Red-Eyes Moon Dragon" and/or "Change Slime - Skull Dragon Mode" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

[REQUIREMENT] Reveal 1 Level 8 monster from your hand if all of the Level 5 or higher monsters in your constructed Deck are Level 8 LIGHT Attribute monsters with 2500 ATK.
[EFFECT] Make 1 monster on the field lose 900 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can apply the following effects.

3: If you control "Borrelend Dragon", or if only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Borrel" monster with 3000 ATK from your Extra Deck or GY, or add 1 "Red Reboot" from outside your Deck to your hand.

You can use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck contains a total of 10 or more cards that mention "Adventurer Token".
1: During this Duel, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0.
2: Reveal 1 monster from your hand that mentions "Adventurer Token", then choose 1 card from your hand, and either send it to the GY or shuffle it back into the Deck. Then, add 2 monsters that mention "Adventurer Token" from your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control an "Adventurer Token" and a monster that mentions "Adventurer Token", or if your opponent controls a monster, add 1 "Curse of Aramatir" from outside your Deck to your hand and Set 1 Trap Card that mentions "Adventurer Token" from outside your Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Mirror Force" from outside your Deck to your hand.
2: If you control "Borreload Dragon" or your opponent controls a monster, play 1 Level 4 or lower DARK Dragon monster from your hand or Graveyard in face-up position.

You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Your normal draw this turn will be 1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster or 1 "Cynet" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck.
2: Reveal 1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster or 1 "Cynet" Card from your hand and either place it at the bottom of your Deck or send it to the GY. Then, draw 2 cards.

[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, reveal 1 "Soleil, the Fairy of Skysavior", "Lua, the Fairy of Skysavior", or "Skysavior Watch" from your hand.
[EFFECT] Send up to 2 cards from your hand or field to the Graveyard, and then draw cards equal to the number of cards you sent to the Graveyard. Then, place 1 "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard on top of your Deck.

[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, reveal 1 "Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut" or "Destructor Soldier Helmet" from your hand if all of the monsters in your Deck are Wyrm Type monsters.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 cards from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand, from among Level 8 monsters, monsters with 400 DEF, "Fusion", Field Spell Cards, and Equip Spell Cards. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during a turn you Normal or Special Summoned "Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut".
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Destructor Soldier Helmet" or 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward before your normal draw. (Once per Duel if going first, twice per Duel if going second.)
[EFFECT] Place 1 Level 1 Wyrm Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard on top of your Deck. In this Draw Phase, if you would draw until you have 5 cards for your normal draw, instead draw until you have 6 cards.

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during a turn you Normal or Special Summoned a monster with 2500 or more ATK.
[EFFECT] Target 1 monster your opponent controls. If it is face-up, change it to face-down Defense Position. If it is in face-down Defense Position, change it to face-up Attack Position.

[REQUIREMENT] Activated at the beginning of the Duel.
[EFFECT] Add 1 "Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut" to your Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies.)

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Black-Winged Dragon" and 1 "Blackwing Armor Master" to your Extra Deck. During this Duel, you cannot Normal or Special Summon Effect Monsters, except "Blackwing" monsters and Level 10 or lower DARK Dragon or Winged Beast Synchro Monsters.
2: Reveal 1 monster in your hand that mentions "Black-Winged Dragon". Add 2 "Blackwing" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
3: If you control a "Blackwing" Synchro Monster, or if your opponent controls a monster. Play 1 "Blackwing Armor Master" from your Extra Deck or Graveyard in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) Then, add 1 "Blackbird Close" from outside your Deck to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck (excluding the Extra Deck) contains 10 or more "Infernity" monsters.
1: Any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, you can only Special Summon 1 monster with an original Level of 9 or higher once per turn, and once per turn, you can activate 1 "Infernity" Trap Card during the turn it was Set.
2: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your hand that are "This Creepy Little Punk" or "Infernity" monsters into the Deck. Send "Infernity" monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard equal to the number shuffled, and if you do, add 1 "Infernity" card from your Deck to your hand.
3: Can be activated from turn 2 onward. Play 3 "Infernity" monsters (1 Level 2, 1 Level 3, 1 Level 4) from your hand and/or Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Their battle positions can be changed.) While a monster played by this effect is on your field, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters.

You can use each of this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Extra Deck contains 5 or more "Code Talker" monsters with different names.
1: Link Monsters on your field gain 500 ATK, and you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Cyberse Link Monsters.
2: Can be activated by revealing 1 Level 3 or lower Cyberse monster or 1 "Cynet Codec" in your hand, and shuffling 1 card from your hand to the Deck. Add up to 2 cards from your Deck to your hand, choosing from "Cyberse Gadget" and "Cynet" Spell/Trap Cards. 
3: Can be activated if you control "Decode Talker", or if your opponent controls a monster. Play 1 "Code Talker" monster from your Extra Deck, and add 1 "Cynet Crosswipe" from outside your Deck to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except LIGHT or DARK monsters that are Level 8 or higher.
2: Reveal 1 "Bystial" monster or 1 "Blazing Cartesia, the Virtuous" in your hand. Send 1 "Fallen of Albaz" from your Deck to the Graveyard, and add 1 "Bystial" monster and 1 monster that mentions "Fallen of Albaz", except "Fallen of Albaz", from your Deck to your hand.
3: Can be activated if only your opponent controls a monster. Send 1 "The Bystial Alba Los" from outside your Deck to the Graveyard. Then, you can add 1 "Bystial" monster from your Deck to your hand.

You can only use each of this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: Any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, and during your Main Phase, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except FIRE monsters and "Diabellstar the Black Witch".
2: Can be activated by revealing 1 Level 1 "Snake-Eye" monster or 1 "Diabellstar the Black Witch" in your hand. Add up to 2 cards from your Deck to your hand, choosing from "Sinful Spoils" Spell/Trap Cards and "Divine Temple of the Snake-Eye".
3: Can be activated if only your opponent controls a monster. Send 1 "Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera" from your Deck to the Graveyard, and Set 1 "WANTED: Seeker of Sinful Spoils" from your Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn. 
1: You cannot Special Summon any monsters from your Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Blackwing" monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.
2: If you control "Black-Winged Dragon", or your opponent controls a monster, draw 2 cards. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn. 
1: You cannot Special Summon any monsters from your Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Infernity" monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.
2: If you control "Infernity Doom Dragon", or your opponent controls a monster, draw 2 cards. Then, send up to 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: At the beginning of your first turn, Set 1 "Toon Bookmark" from outside your Deck to your field.
2: Can be activated if you control "Toon World" by shuffling 1 monster from your hand to the Deck. Add 1 Toon monster from your Deck to your hand. If you returned a Toon monster to activate this effect, you can also draw 1 card.

skills.n: Deep Blue of the Mother Ocean
skills.d:
You can use each of this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel if your Deck (excluding the Extra Deck) contains 10 or more "Marincess" cards.
1: You cannot Normal or Special Summon any monsters, except WATER monsters, and any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, except effect damage of "Marincess" cards.
2: Reveal 1 Level 4 "Marincess" monster or "Marincess" Spell Card from your hand, then add up to 2 "Marincess" monsters from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard or shuffle it into the Deck.
3: If your opponent controls a monster, or you control a Link 4 monster, add 1 "Marincess" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand, then place 1 "Marincess Wonder Heart" from your Extra Deck in your Extra Monster Zone.

You can only use each of this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: Any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0.
2: Reveal 1 "Visas Starfrost" from your hand, then add 1 "Scareclaw Reichheart" and 1 "Scareclaw Arrival" from your Deck to your hand.
3: If your opponent controls a monster, or you control "Scareclaw Tri-Heart", set 1 "Scareclaw" Spell/Trap Card from your hand or Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 2 "Primathmech Alembertian" and 3 "Mathmech Circular" from outside your Deck to your Deck or Extra Deck. During this Duel, you cannot Normal or Special Summon (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck) any monsters, except "Mathmech" monsters, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, and if your "Mathmech" Synchro Monster attacks a Defense Position monster, and the attacking monster's ATK is higher than the defense of the target, inflict battle damage equal to the difference between the attacking monster's ATK and the target's DEF.
2: Reveal 1 "Mathmech" Tuner from your hand and send 1 card from your hand or field to the Graveyard, then add 2 "Mathmech" monsters from your Deck to your hand. If it is turn 2 onward, you can also set 1 "Mathmech" Spell/Trap Card from your hand or Deck. (This card can be activated the same turn.)

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Trickstar Holly Angel" to your Extra Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies of each card.)
2: Can be used before your normal draw from the second turn onward. Your normal draw this turn will be a random LIGHT Fairy monster.

skills.n: New Possibilities for Me and Aqua!
skills.d:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Marincess Great Bubble Reef" and 1 "Marincess Coral Anemone" to your Extra Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies of each card.)
2: If you control a Link Monster, play 1 "Marincess" monster from your Graveyard in face-up Defense Position.

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated from turn 2 onward by revealing 1 Level 7 or higher monster or a Normal Monster from your hand if all the monsters in your constructed Deck are Psychic Type and all of the Level 7 or higher monsters are "Prima Guitarna the Shining Superstar" and/or "Esperade the Smashing Superstar".
[Effect] Add up to 2 monsters that are Level 1, 4, or 7 LIGHT Attribute monsters, Normal Monsters, and/or "Fusion" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

[REQUIREMENT] From turn 2 onward, revealing 1 monster with 2500 ATK from your hand if all of the monsters in your constructed Deck are Level 7 or below LIGHT Attribute Machine Type monsters with either 1600 or less ATK or 2400 or more ATK, and either 200 DEF or 1600 or more DEF.
[EFFECT] Add up to 2 monsters (max. 1 each) with 200 DEF from your Deck to your hand. Then, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

[REQUIREMENT] Can be activated during the turn you Normal Summoned "Air Formula Eagle".
[EFFECT] 1 face-up monster on your field gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 "Following World", "Atrium's Wind", or "Against Buster" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand. (Each card once per Duel.)

[REQUIREMENT] Once per Duel, if you have a face-up "Destructor Wyrm Bakhamut" monster on your field.
[EFFECT] Set 1 "Destructor Art - Total Destruction" from your Deck or Graveyard in your Spell & Trap Zone.

skills.n: Light the Way to the Future
skills.d:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: Any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0, except for effect damage from cards that mention "Shining Sarcophagus".
2: Reveal 1 Spellcaster monster that mentions "Shining Sarcophagus" from your hand. Add up to 2 cards from your Deck to your hand, choosing from "Shining Sarcophagus" and monsters that mention it. If only your opponent controls a card, you can also play 1 "Silent Swordsman Zero" from your hand or Deck.
3: From turn 2 onward, send 1 "Silent Swordsman Zero" from your field to the Graveyard, then play 1 "Silent Swordsman LV7" from outside of your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.) If you control "Shining Sarcophagus", add 1 "Silent Sword Slash" from outside of your Deck to your hand.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the start of your first turn, send 1 "Cyber Dragon" from your Deck to the Graveyard. During this Duel, any effect damage your cards would inflict to your opponent becomes 0.
2: Reveal 1 "Cyber Dragon" or "Cyber Jormungardr" from your hand. Add up to 2 Level 2 or lower "Cyber Dragon" monsters from your Deck to your hand. Then, Set 1 "Cybernetic Overflow" from outside of your Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.)
3: From turn 2 onward, add up to 3 "Cyber Dragon" from your Deck and/or Graveyard to your hand. During this Duel, unless you successfully Special Summon "Cyber End Dragon", you cannot activate the effects of Spell Cards other than "Polymerization" and "Power Bond".

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 12 Fusion Monsters to your Extra Deck. During this Duel, you can only Special Summon "Neos", "Elemental HERO", and "Neo-Spacian" monsters, and you can activate "Super Polymerization" and "Favorite Contact" the turn they are Set.
2: Reveal 1 "Elemental HERO Spirit of Neos" or "Miracle Ejector" from your hand. Add 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck and 1 "Polymerization" from outside of your Deck to your hand.
3: If you control "Elemental HERO Spirit of Neos" or your opponent controls a monster, Set up to 1 "Super Polymerization" and up to 1 "E - Emergency Call" from your Deck to your field.

You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Shining Sarcophagus" and 1 "Silent Swordsman Zero" to your Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies of each card.)
2: Can be used before your normal draw. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be "Shining Sarcophagus" from your Deck.
3: Reveal 1 monster that mentions "Shining Sarcophagus" from your hand, then either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Dark Necrofear" to your Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies.)
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your Life Points are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random DARK Fiend monster from your Deck.

skills.n: Make a Miracle with Your Shining Wings!
skills.d:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Elemental HERO Shining Flare Wingman" and 1 "Elemental HERO Shining Neos Wingman" to your Extra Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies of each card.)
2: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Elemental HERO Shining Flare Wingman" from your Extra Deck.
3: If you control "Elemental HERO Shining Flare Wingman", Set 1 "Favorite Contact" from outside your Deck to your field.

You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Cyber End Dragon" to your Extra Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies.)
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your Life Points are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random LIGHT Machine monster from your Deck.
